<thought>Based on the pairwise resistance measurements, a tree (no loops) with four resistors connecting the five nodes fits perfectly. Assuming a series chain X2‑R1‑N_c1‑R2‑N_c2‑R3‑N_c3‑R4‑X3, the individual resistances are:
- R1 (X2‑N_c1) = 5 Ω
- R2 (N_c1‑N_c2) = 10 Ω
- R3 (N_c2‑N_c3) = 15 Ω
- R4 (N_c3‑X3) = 20 Ω

All given measurements are exactly the sums of the appropriate series segments, confirming this topology.

Thus the required JSON describing the circuit is:</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 5.0, "R2": 10.0, "R3": 15.0, "R4": 20.0}, "connections": [["X2","N_c1","R1"], ["N_c1","N_c2","R2"], ["N_c2","N_c3","R3"], ["N_c3","X3","R4"]]}</final_answer>
